name: budget-tracker-dev
description: Dev tooling for the Budget Tracker Obsidian plugin. The plugin itself is main.js, styles.css and manifest.json and has no build step.

scripts.build: node --check main.js && echo "No build step: main.js, styles.css and manifest.json are the plugin as written."
scripts.check: node --check main.js && node tools/tdz-scan.js && node tools/snapshot.js && node tests/run-tests.js
